white: D50 media-relative to G3 (the mode's own white = L* 100)
method: i1Pro S/N 324492, reflective, M0, bare panel on EE04 OD7C42E9; two reads per level, tile drift 0.5 % Y; levels drawn by preset 0x0015's full LUTs with the planes swapped (the gray4 mode)
codes: the 2-bit code py-opendisplay sends for the level (u8Colors_4gray: level 0..3 -> 3, 1, 2, 0)
